messages:
Alex Rivera: Hey team — just got my dock and monitor deliveries. Dock powers on but my laptop isn’t charging when plugged into the dock, and the monitor stays blank. Anyone I should ping for a quick check?
Priya (IT): @Alex Rivera sorry you hit this on day 1 — can you confirm the dock model (it's written on a sticker) and whether the dock's power LED is solid or blinking? Also try unplugging the dock power and plugging it back in.
Alex Rivera: Dock model: USB4-DK-02 (sticker: SN U4-3387). Power LED is amber solid. Tried unplug/replug. Laptop still shows "Not charging" and monitor (Dell U2422) stays black. I swapped the USB-C cable with my laptop charger cable — same behavior.
Priya (IT): OK thanks. Can you run `lsusb` (mac: `system_profiler SPUSBDataType`) or paste the macOS battery indicator status? Also can you attach a pic of the power brick label (just the model and wattage)?
Alex Rivera: Pic attached: https://img.redwood-company/internal/attachments/IMG_20260312_1.jpg — says 65W. Battery menu says "Not Charging" but power adapter detected. Monitor never wakes.
Priya (IT): Looks like the dock might be underpowered for your machine. We'll RMA the dock and ship a 90W power brick + replacement dock. Creating ticket now. Can you confirm your day-to-day shipping address and whether you can drop by SF office to swap if it's faster?
Molly Onboarding: Welcome Alex! If you need a loaner monitor while this gets sorted, we have a spare in the SF office — @Alex Rivera you can pick it up from reception, ask for "Onboarding Loaner".
it-support-bot: Ticket #78942 created: "USB4 dock - not providing charge, monitor not detected" — assignee: Priya (IT) — ETA parts order 2 business days.
Alex Rivera: Thanks all. I’m remote but I can accept shipment — shipping address: 821 Market St, Apt 4B, San Francisco, CA 94103. ETA pickup from carrier fine. Appreciate the loaner offer but shipment is easiest. Any temp fixes in the meantime?
Priya (IT): We'll send a temporary USB-A -> USB-C PD adapter in the same shipment so you can at least charge directly. Replacement dock + 90W brick should arrive in ~48 hours. I’ll update ticket #78942 with tracking.
Alex Rivera: Awesome, thank you! :raised_hands:
